core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hafsa is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Young lioness”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hafsa corresponds to the Arabic form حفصة (Arabic حفصة (Ḥafṣa) — traditionally connected with 'young lioness'). Its core sense is young lioness, lion cub. Hafsa (حفصة) is a prominent Arabic feminine name, borne by Ḥafṣa bint ʿUmar, a wife of the Prophet. It is traditionally glossed 'young lioness' (compare the lion-name family). persian.name: حفصه
persian.long_meaning: Hafsa (حفصه) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن شیرزن، بچه‌شیر است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: हफ़्सा

arabic.name: حفصة
